The '''Deretta system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Deretta]].
